Both pathways converge on FaDu as a downstream target, suggesting that Tiapride may influence FaDu through different molecular mechanisms. The integration of these pathways highlights a potential role for Tiapride in modulating FaDu activity, possibly through distinct biochemical routes. The evidence supports a relationship between Tiapride and FaDu, with the shared target of FaDu serving as a key ontological link that unifies the two pathways.
